required_invariants.description: Buscador is only APTO when OpenAI, Claude and Gemini are active and each returns a non-empty visible response in the same real chat cycle; research mode also requires research, critique and converge for all three and real consensus.
Admin authentication and a complete Buscador chat cycle must be executed in the real graphical browser.
ok=true/configured/health alone never certifies the product; provider response behavior must be proven.
Fable must not appear in any active Buscador preset/transport path.
OpenAI/Claude/Gemini transport authentication must be live-verified according to the documented allowed transport chain.
